items.text: I’m being pitched a new inference neocloud company on average every two days. No exaggeration. I take every entrepreneur seriously and I look deeply into each. But it’s hard to fathom this being sustainable. At the same time, AI Gateway token demand on Vercel has been ~40% MoM compounded since the beginning of the year. No signs of stopping. One way to reconcile this is that compute is the new economy, and tokens the new energy unit. There’s a new Industrial Revolution taking place.
